name: OMV Raststation
kurzbeschreibung:
**OMV Service Area in Tirol**

Welcome to our **OMV Raststation** in the heart of **Tirol** – your perfect stop for a break, refueling, and a taste of the region’s finest.

**Fuel up & relax**
Fill your tank with premium **OMV** fuels and enjoy our modern facilities, including clean restrooms, a baby changing station, and plenty of space for a quick rest.

**Culinary delights**
Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** flavors at our restaurant. Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Apfelstrudel**, or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**. For a quick bite, grab a **Brez’n** or a **Kaffee mit Schlag**.

**Explore Tirol**
Just a stone’s throw away, you’ll find breathtaking landscapes. Visit **Innsbruck**, the charming capital of **Tirol**, or head to the **Zillertal** or **Ötztal** for hiking, skiing, or simply soaking in the alpine beauty.

**Shop & services**
Stock up on local specialties like **Tiroler Speck**, **Käse** (cheese), or **Obstler** (fruit brandy) in our shop. Need help? Our team is happy to assist with car maintenance, tire checks, or even a quick oil change.

**Family-friendly**
Kids will love our play area, while parents can relax with a coffee or a snack. We also offer free Wi-Fi and charging stations for your devices.

**Plan your journey**
Use our **OMV Route Planner** to find the best way to your next destination. Whether you're heading to **Salzburg**, **München**, or the **Dolomiten**, we’re here to make your trip smooth and enjoyable.

**Stay connected**
Follow us on social media for updates, special offers, and travel tips. **#OMVTirol #TravelInStyle**

Drive safely and enjoy your time in **Tirol**!
